items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: And the piano player was a guy named Kirk-Kilpatrick, who was also a great arranger at that time around Miami.

ctx.x: And that was the first time I had ever seen a trombone with a great big bell on it. I don't know where Denny Morton got this trombone from, but it had an extra large bell on it, you know? And it really was impressive to me.
And the piano player was a guy named Kirk-Kilpatrick, who was also a great arranger at that time around Miami.
Who was the drummer in that band?
